table.name: TLGNC_RFIDTAG
table.description: The actual RFID tag/sticker which is placed on an RFID-taggable physical object.

column.name: RFIDOBJECT_ID
column.description: The physical object which is identified by this RFID. The same RFID-object may be identified by several tags. If null: tag is not assigned to an object.

column.name: NAME
column.description: The human readable (short) name, which is for example written on the tag.

column.name: RFID_IDENTITY
column.description: The actual RFID, i.e. the technical relevant (unique) code sent out by the tag, e.g. E00401003162A00C.
